create_Mahalanobis_metric: create a Mahalanobis metric instance from the HuggingFace evaluate library for computing distances
compute_Mahalanobis_distance: compute the Mahalanobis distance between datapoints and a reference distribution
get_Mahalanobis_info: get the metric info including description, citation, and input features for the Mahalanobis metric
validate_Mahalanobis_input: validate that X and reference_distribution are 2D arrays with sufficient elements
